command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get; `$hits=`$r.output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^ip route-static|150\.0\.0\.1|160\.0\.0\.1'}; if(`$hits){Write-Output ('### '+`$p+' '+`$n); Write-Output `$hits}}}}"
